==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*grǫzъ}}, itself possibly deverbal of {{m|sla-pro|*gręzti|t=to sink}}. Compare {{cog|uk|грузь}} and {{cog|pl|grąz}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-груз.ogg}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Tatiana Kerbush-груз.wav|a=Saint Petersburg}}

===Noun===
{{ru-noun+|adj=грузово́й}}

# [[weight]], [[load]]
#: {{syn|ru|тя́жесть<g:f><t:heavy load>}}
# {{lb|ru|figuratively}} [[burden]]
#: {{syn|ru|бре́мя}}
# {{lb|ru|engineering}} [[weight]], [[counterweight]]
# [[cargo]], [[freight]], [[lading]]
#: {{syn|ru|ка́рго<g:n>}}

==Russian==

===Etymology===
Borrowed from {{af|ru|inszenieren|lang1=de|-овать}}, from {{cog|de|[[in]] [[Szene]]||[[in]] [[scene]]}}. See also {{af|ru|-и́ровать}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|инсцени́ровать}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|инсцени́ровать|both}}

# to [[adapt]] (a [[literary]] [[work]]) for [[theater]], to [[film]] or [[television]]; to [[stage]] (a [[literary]] [[work]])

====Conjugation====

{{ru-conj|impf|2a+p|инсцени́ровать}}
''perfective''
